name: Legora
long_description:
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Built alongside lawyers, our AI-native workspace helps legal teams research, review documents, draft and complete complex workflows so they can focus on judgment, strategy and outcomes.

More than 2,100 customers across 80+ markets trust Legora, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons and Barclays. We have scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with more than 900 people across 18 offices spanning Europe, North America and APAC.

Legora raised $600M in Series D financing, including a $50M extension announced in April 2026, at a $5.6B valuation. The round was led by Accel, with Atlassian and NVentures joining in the extension.

Learn more at https://legora.com/
one_liner: The agentic operating system for legal work

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
Legora was founded in 2023 to build AI software for legal work. The company develops its platform alongside lawyers, combining research, document review, drafting and end-to-end workflows.

In March 2026, Legora announced a $550M Series D led by Accel. A [$50M extension announced in April 2026](https://legora.com/newsroom/legora-extends-series-d-with-additional-50-million-welcomes-atlassian-and-nventures-as-investors) brought the round to $600M at a $5.6B valuation, with Atlassian and NVentures joining as investors.

Legora now serves more than 2,100 customers across 80+ markets and has scaled to $200M+ ARR. In October 2026, the company reported more than 900 people across 18 offices.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Legal teams work with large volumes of documents, fragmented information and complex, time-sensitive matters. Repetitive research, review and drafting can take time away from the judgment, strategy and client advice that require legal expertise.

Legora brings AI, information and collaboration into one workspace so legal professionals can research, review, draft and complete workflows with greater speed and precision. We build alongside lawyers to make the product useful in the way legal teams actually work.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
Our vision is to give every lawyer the tools and freedom to focus on what matters most: advising clients and stakeholders, shaping outcomes and practising law at the highest level.

We are building the operating system for legal work, connecting information, communication and execution. AI should complement legal expertise, helping teams work together with confidence, efficiency and sharper judgment.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Max is the CEO and co-founder of Leya, where he focuses on developing trustworthy AI assistants for lawyers. Prior to Leya, Max contributed to growth initiatives at two Y Combinator startups, worked at McKinsey, engaged in venture capital, and served as a software developer at Abios (acquired by Kambi) and Ericsson. He earned two degrees in machine learning and business from Sweden's top two universities, KTH and SSE, in parallel whilst working full-time.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Family tech support. I can reset grandparents' forgotten email passwords, and I plug in the HDMI for siblings. Graduated from Hyper Island and worked as a full-stack developer at startups since. Founded the first-ever Mexican hops company, but currently building the future of legal work at Leya (W24).
